scientific_limitations_and_integrity.assumptions: Positive mean reversion and timestep; nonzero additive-noise amplitude; deterministic initial condition; no discretization of the random ODE.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.exact_scope: Single scalar Ornstein–Uhlenbeck step, exact integration of finite smooth sine-bridge forcing, endpoint-preserving canonical Gaussian coefficients, mean-square endpoint loss.
limits: Not an optimality statement over arbitrary random path approximations or arbitrary Gaussian variables.
Not a performance guarantee for nonlinear SDEs, full numerical SDC schemes, global multi-step errors, or exact OU marginal simulation.
Some older specialized equivalent analyses may remain unidentified; no external independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.provenance: Mathematical analysis motivated by published numerical SDE approximation literature, with references and limitations disclosed and no independent external audit claimed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.reproducibility: Proof is analytic; an embedded standard-library script checks independent quadrature, coefficient rankings, series truncation and boundary numerical values.

title: A sharp mode-bypass transition for Brownian-bridge approximations of Ornstein–Uhlenbeck endpoints
